inlines.v: ACCOM'MODATING, participle present tense Adapting; making suitable; reconciling; furnishing with conveniences; applying. ACCOM'MODATING, adjective Adapting one's self to; obliging; yielding to the desires of others; disposed to comply, and to oblige another; as an accommodating man.
